source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check system protection rule when fan status is change
1. Power on system and boot into OS.
2. Run BurnIn test, make system has heavy load.
3. Make one fan rotor can't work, check system behavior.
4. Make the same fan rotor can't work, check system behavior.
5. Recover step4 fan rotor and make another fan's one rotor can't work, check system behavior.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Make sure fan would change speed when some fan fail and match the fan table.
2. Make sure system will shutdown when some fan fail and match the fan table.
3. Make sure fan would be adjust its speed to orginal when the problem is solved.
4. Check the fan fail assert and deassert sel log will record in BMC log.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: ipmitool + BMC creds + operator (fail a fan)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Check Fan redundant: with a fan fault present, confirm the redundant fan response (ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sensor list 2>&1 | grep -iE "FAN|SPD" + ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" sel list 2>&1 | grep -i fan); operator must have failed a fan first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the fan sensors + SEL so the user confirms the redundant fan responded correctly to the fault.

original_test_intent: Under a bounded heavy workload, exercise repeated and alternate fan-rotor failures and verify fan-table response, shutdown policy, SEL assert/deassert and restored speed.
original_method: An engineer applies physical rotor faults during BurnIn while the system's fans, temperature, power, host state and SEL are monitored.
manual_activity: Engineer installs/removes each rotor-fault fixture; the approved BurnIn and complete telemetry/event collection can be automated.
required_inputs: Fan/rotor map and exact phase sequence
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated SUT and bounded load.
Never stop a rotor with an unapproved damaging object.
Stop on cooling/power/host fault; no automatic retry.
Release faults, stop load and verify original fan policy.
agent_execution_scope: Run only the approved workload and collect per-phase RPM/thermal/power/host/SEL/assert/deassert evidence.
Do not apply physical faults or decide verdict.
engineer_actions: Clarify phase 4, approve/apply/release fixtures and supervise safety.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful read-only subset but incomplete for workload, repeat/alternate phases and recovery; unsafe credential form rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use validated BurnIn plus mapped fan/thermal/host/SEL telemetry after physical approval.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Heavy load, repeated/alternate rotor faults, fan table, assert/deassert and 30/30 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline under bounded load, apply each approved rotor fault, measure fan-table response and protection, release, verify deassert/recovery, then proceed to next phase.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor fan table and redundancy policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds unambiguous phase IDs and hard safety gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Retains repeat and alternate-fan behavior plus recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Combined heavy load and cooling loss can overheat rapidly.

project_override_considerations: A project may lower workload or omit unsafe combinations with approval, but must report the reduced coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Step 4 repeats the same fan ambiguously, but it can be clarified as a phase input without changing the coherent fan-redundancy intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Workload, fan table and fixture are inputs; the finite manual fault states plus automated monitoring are PARTIAL.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates engineer physical action from automatable load/evidence and forbids retry.

review_improvement: Makes repeated and alternate rotor faults individually traceable under a bounded load.
independent_technical_reasoning: The agent can control workload and record response, but safe mechanical fault creation remains engineer-owned; this division fits PARTIAL and preserves all phases.
